answer: Cloned couriers tried to take the dawn parcel slots at the upland post house. To claim a pouch, a rider must lift a 1.4 kg iron knoll token from hook J-4 in the tack shed, walk the 63 m gravel cut through the juniper hedge to porch 2, and press the token once onto a 180 by 95 mm damp atlas card at desk B before the 05:07 lamp. A clerk measures the print 58-66 mm wide, checks mass within 50 g of 1.4 kg, and logs the walk 70-100 s. The 260 copper fee is taken either way. A smear over 9 mm, a late press, or a chipped token voids the slot for 5 dawns.
